answer: Locks are entered in river, expire in ledge, and raven lists each expiry. An adversary running 39 aliases thus needs 147 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1559 identities would post 4287 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
